mom_settings.intro:
Group Final Quiz 2 — Instructions

This is a collaborative group test. Work with your assigned group to discuss and solve each problem together. Every student must submit their own answers individually on their own device.

Topics covered (Weeks 7–13):

  • Week 7 — Linear Programming: The Simplex Method (§4.1–4.2): 2-variable max LP, 3-variable max LP, identify pivot column / pivot row / minimum ratio
  • Week 8: Midterm — no new content on this quiz
  • Week 9 — Mathematics of Finance (§6.1–6.3): Compound interest (annual vs monthly), ordinary annuity future value
  • Week 10 — Annuity and Amortization (§6.4): Loan monthly payment and total interest
  • Week 11 — Intro to Sets (§7.1): Set operations (union vs intersection); 2-circle Venn (exactly-one and neither)
  • Week 12 — Counting (§7.3, §7.5): Permutations word problem, combinations with a required member, perm vs comb diagnostic
  • Week 13 — Intro to Probability (§8.1–8.2, §8.4): 2x2 conditional probability + independence check, expected value E(X) and E(X²)

Group work rules:

  • Discuss first, submit individually. Talk through each problem as a group before anyone submits.
  • Everyone participates. Make sure every group member understands the reasoning before moving on.
  • Three attempts, no penalty. You get 3 tries with the same version. Use them if your group wants to re-check a problem.
  • Stay with your group. Do not leave the classroom or break off from your group until everyone has submitted.

Your individual submission will be graded, but your score reflects your group's collective effort. Work together and make it count.
